prompt: What Indian Empire was overrun by Huns 24 years after conventionally accepted date of the fall of the Western Roman Empire?
answer: The **Gupta Empire** of India was overrun by the Hunas around **500 CE**, 24 years after the conventional fall of the Western Roman Empire in **476 CE**.
